overall.one_line_summary: Execution adoption is structurally blocked because the frozen v15 package does not bind a complete measured executor.
strengths: The clean bundle identity, protected handoff, 25 compiled bindings, deterministic replay, zero-silent-truncation policy, live provider inputs, whole-workload budget, and watchdog are independently validated.
The gate order held: no measured retrieval or GPU scientific process began after the missing executor was identified.
weaknesses: The frozen package has no manifest or source binding for the complete embedding, BM25, vector index/search, checkpoint, and safe-export execution path.
Historical App implementations are provenance references only and are explicitly unavailable as active runtime authority.

strengths: The REP-DEV role and OUT metric roles are frozen.
weaknesses: No measured result can exist before a valid executor is adopted.

strengths: The 25-of-25, replay, token-drop, budget, heartbeat, and safe-return rejection rules are explicit.
weaknesses: Those rules are not independently executable without the missing runner.

strengths: The request stops before A2, HARNESS-DEV, Selection, and Final.
weaknesses: Scientific scope cannot be assessed from a non-runnable package.

strengths: The program, overflow, compiler, split, metric, transfer, and result contracts form a traceable design chain.
weaknesses: The chain ends at compiled inputs and never reaches a hash-bound measured execution implementation.

strengths: Failed watchdog attempts and the present adoption failure remain recorded.
weaknesses: There is no adopted trial to evaluate.

strengths: Frozen scientific semantics and protected boundaries remain intact.
weaknesses: Reproducibility is incomplete because the measured executor identity and its entrypoint/dependency/checkpoint/export bindings are absent.
suggestions: Under separate Owner authorization, package the complete executor additively and bind every executed byte without changing v11-v15 scientific semantics.

findings.evidence_locator: The bundle contains 76 regular members and 18 source members. Source inventory contains no dense model executor, bm25s runtime, vector index/search implementation, durable measured checkpoint implementation, or safe-export writer. Historical hashes 5629b397..., 3fb6e623..., aa17039b..., and 3a6aca14... are absent from the bundle; control/armindex/a0.10-legacy-code-harvest-ledger.v1.json classifies the relevant App code as reference/blocked and forbids runtime import.
findings.observation: The package can compile and validate 25 protected bindings but cannot independently produce the required ranking results.
findings.reasoning: Using current HEAD, v9 synthetic code, historical App code, or a one-off script would substitute an unbound execution identity after adoption inputs were frozen and would invalidate reproducibility and gate order.
findings.suggestion: Do not adopt or launch. Obtain an explicit Owner decision for an additive packaging repair that freezes the complete measured executor, entrypoint, dependency lock, checkpoint contract, safe-export contract, and hashes while preserving v11-v15 scientific semantics.
